description: This file defines the ReadReportingService interface, which provides method signatures for retrieving and generating reports within the Fineract project. It includes methods for fetching report lists, report details, report types, report parameters, and generating report outputs in PDF and CSV formats, as well as some specialized data retrieval methods.

classes.name: ReadReportingService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reporting operations such as fetching report data, generating PDFs and CSVs, and retrieving report parameters within the system.

methods.name: retrieveReportList
methods.description: Returns a collection of all available report data objects.

methods.name: retrieveReport
methods.description: Fetches detailed report data for the specified report ID.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Determines the type of report based on report name and user context flags.

methods.name: getAllowedParameters
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of parameters that are permitted for report filtering or customization.

methods.name: retrieveReportPDF
methods.description: Generates a PDF version of a report based on provided parameters.

methods.name: retrieveReportCSV
methods.description: Generates a CSV stream of a report based on provided parameters.

methods.name: retrieveGenericResultset
methods.description: Retrieves a generic result set for a report based on query parameters.

methods.name: retrieveGenericResultSetForSmsEmailCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves a result set specifically for SMS or email campaign reports, where security context may be null.

methods.name: generatePentahoReportAsOutputStream
methods.description: Generates a Pentaho report as an output stream considering locale, user context, and error logging.
